definitions.explanation: A very common Japanese surname, literally meaning 'mountain rice field.'

examples.japanese: {山田|やまだ}{夫妻|ふさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧30⟦{周年|しゅうねん}→周年：09520_shuunen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The Yamadas will celebrate their 30th wedding anniversary next month.

examples.japanese: {山田|やまだ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：00607_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：01310_ippanteki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{名字|みょうじ}→名字：02679_myouji⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Yamada is a common surname in Japan.

notes:
{山田|やまだ} is one of the most common Japanese surnames.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {山|やま}: mountain
- {田|た/だ}: rice field
- Literally: "mountain rice field"
